aiReadyLines.text: Unit Six : Leisure 61
Lesson 5: Travelling by Train (2)
Keywords : departure, empty, printout
Ask and answer this question:
Have you ever looked through the window from a running train? If
you have, what did you see?
Read about a train journey.
Zishan, Julie and their parents Mr and Mrs Arif Khan got into a 1*
class compartment at Kamalapur Railway Station. It was the Dewanganj-
bound Tista Express. Zishan saw that the departure time on the big time
table of the station was 7:30 am, but the train left at 8 o’clock. However,
the train was running quite fast. The children sat by the window beside
their parents. The compartment was half empty.
Yesterday Julie had downloaded a beautiful poem on a train journey by
Robert Louis Stevenson, and printed out a copy of the poem. She took a
printout of the poem. Now while looking out of the windows, she found
similarities between the poem and real scenery. She took out the poem
and began to read.
Were all the seats in the compartment taken?
Where did Zishan sit?
Where was the train going?
Did the train leave Kamalapur Station late or on time?
Where did Julie get the poem from?
What was Julie doing from her seat?

rawText:
Unit Six : Leisure 61
Lesson 5: Travelling by Train (2)
Keywords : departure, empty, printout
A. Ask and answer this question:
Have you ever looked through the window from a running train? If
you have, what did you see?
Read about a train journey.
Zishan, Julie and their parents Mr and Mrs Arif Khan got into a 1*
class compartment at Kamalapur Railway Station. It was the Dewanganj-
bound Tista Express. Zishan saw that the departure time on the big time
table of the station was 7:30 am, but the train left at 8 o’clock. However,
the train was running quite fast. The children sat by the window beside
their parents. The compartment was half empty.
Yesterday Julie had downloaded a beautiful poem on a train journey by
Robert Louis Stevenson, and printed out a copy of the poem. She took a
printout of the poem. Now while looking out of the windows, she found
similarities between the poem and real scenery. She took out the poem
and began to read.
Questions
Were all the seats in the compartment taken?
Where did Zishan sit?
Where was the train going?
Did the train leave Kamalapur Station late or on time?
Where did Julie get the poem from?
What was Julie doing from her seat?
